PanelDevice.description: One device's panel data: its family and what differs from it on this device.

family.description: The record template the device instantiates (a family file's name).
family.title: Family

prefix.description: The device's PV prefix, ending in ':', for a device on a bench IOC (not in native_devices.yaml). Absent: '<experiment>:<device>:'.
prefix.title: Prefix

axes.description: A per-axis family's axes (the motor record names under the prefix), for a device the registry does not list.
axes.title: Axes

roles.description: Role → this device's own record suffix, where it differs from the family's (a supply's IOC names its own PVs).
roles.title: Roles

labels.description: Role → what this device's page calls it (a bit's label: 'chiller flow').
labels.title: Labels

allow.description: The family actions the page may take on this device (no homing for actuators on a mirror mount). Absent: every action.
allow.title: Allow

note.description: A line the device's page shows.
note.title: Note

omit.description: Family roles this device does not have or use (an unwired interlock): never read, never shown, and their actions are unavailable.
omit.title: Omit

hazard.description: Writable roles that need the hazard confirm on this device, beyond the family's own (one stage's move).
hazard.title: Hazard

archive.description: Roles the archiver takes on this device beyond the family's own.
archive.title: Archive

no_archive.description: Roles the family archives that the archiver leaves out on this device (a readback too noisy to keep); the page still shows them.
no_archive.title: No Archive

ioc.description: The IOC serving the device, as its host's compose file names it (IOC_NAME, e.g. 'adtest-cam1'): the archiver keeps that IOC's devIocStats heartbeat. Absent: no heartbeat for it.
ioc.title: Ioc

PanelDevice.title: PanelDevice

description:
The experiment's devices with a panel: each one's family and per-device panel data.

``<experiment>/panel_devices.yaml`` in the configs repository, read by
the native-device readers (module docstring). A device here may still be owned by the GEECS DB
(a bench device): the scan worker reads ``native_devices.yaml``, never
this file.

schema_version.description: Format version of this config file. Leave at 1 — tools update this automatically when the file format changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

devices.description: GEECS device name → its family and panel data.
devices.title: Devices

title: PanelDevices
